title: Postpartum Depression
subtitle: What postpartum depression is, causes, risk factors, symptoms, evaluation, management, lifestyle considerations, and safety.
evidence_strength: Established evidence from clinical guidelines and systematic reviews supports definitions, screening, and standard treatment approaches for postpartum depression. Emerging evidence is noted in lifestyle interventions and digital health applications. Some uncertainties remain regarding optimal pharmacotherapy during breastfeeding and personalized treatment strategies.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
